title: PV Sindhu Criticizes Gruelling Asian Games Schedule After Quarterfinal Exit
indian_angle: India's top female shuttler, PV Sindhu, voiced concerns about the demanding schedule at the Asian Games following her quarterfinal loss.
summary: PV Sindhu expressed her frustration over playing three matches in 18 hours, which she believes contributed to her early exit from the Asian Games.

title: Sindhu Reflects on Asian Games Exit: "One Painful Result Cannot Define a Journey"
indian_angle: Indian badminton star PV Sindhu shared a reflective message after her Asian Games quarterfinal loss, emphasizing her long-term career perspective.
summary: Following her Asian Games quarterfinal defeat, PV Sindhu posted a message acknowledging the disappointment but highlighting that a single result does not define her extensive career.

title: National Coaching Camp Begins for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: India's brightest young talents are gathering at NCE, Guwahati, for a crucial national coaching camp ahead of the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has commenced a national coaching camp at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Launches Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skill set of Indian badminton coaches, directly impacting player development across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, to upgrade coaching standards.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp at NCE Guwahati is preparing India's young shuttlers for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will affect all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
